observation: User wants high-quality slide and worksheet creation with minimal handholding and automatic learning from output comments.
action: Added inference defaults, verification gates, feedback capture, and evidence-based promotion rules.

observation: Use the Markdown grammar book directly and remove the embedding corpus.
action: Replaced vector retrieval with heading-aware Markdown BM25 search, added retrieval evaluation, updated provenance, and removed embeddings.jsonl.

observation: Teacher requested an ink-friendly worksheet.
action: Replace solid colour areas with white backgrounds, thin black or grey outlines, and minimal light-grey shading; retain readable hierarchy.

observation: For future topic worksheets, use an ink-saving design; place the worksheet title and Name, Class, and Date fields only on page 1; reduce unnecessary response lines and omit nonessential or repeated text.
action: Promoted the requirements into AGENTS.md worksheet print-design defaults and consolidated the active worksheet preference.

observation: User requested the whole lesson content be redone using a new 10-slide interactive smartboard plan.
action: Replace the current 8-slide sequence with the supplied 10-slide challenge, evidence, trap, mission, and transfer sequence while preserving the smartboard Android profile.

observation: Teacher reports Slide 1 has an awkward design; the title, outcome prompt, and reminder compete visually.
action: Redesign Slide 1 as a cleaner title-and-outcomes composition with clearer hierarchy and less competing chrome.

observation: Teacher reports the learning-outcome phrasing on Slide 1 is too simple and may not be understood by students.
action: Rewrite outcomes as concrete student actions with examples and explicit evidence language.

observation: Teacher reports the app remains broken and the clearer learning outcomes were removed during the attempted fix.
action: Rebuild the deck as valid static HTML with one navigation controller and restore the explicit student-friendly outcomes.

observation: Quality review found missing match validation, keyboard-navigation conflicts, immediate answer reveal, undersized pupil text, and whole-deck reset behaviour.
action: Added controlled match feedback, keyboard focus protection, separate recall/reveal, larger pupil text, balanced cards, and current-board reset.

observation: User asked to save a new device profile for their MacBook: DPR 2.00, browser viewport 1710px x 985px, screen size 1710px x 1107px.
action: Register the MacBook device profile for future deck viewport targeting and verification, alongside the existing smartboard-android profile convention.

observation: Teacher primarily teaches Form 1 and Form 2 English with varied temperament, proficiency, and needs.
action: Stored English-only Form 1/Form 2 teaching context as an active durable preference.

observation: Some lessons happen offline or outside the app, so local deck history may not show the previous lesson; lesson continuity and bridging must be actively checked.
action: Promoted continuity check rules into AGENTS.md and instructional-slide-decks/SKILL.md.

observation: Grammar book is the only local reference; listening, reading, writing, and other English-skill lessons need active source searching when local knowledge is insufficient.
action: Promoted non-grammar English pedagogy sourcing rule into AGENTS.md and instructional-slide-decks/SKILL.md.

observation: Interactive slide controls have sometimes been visible but non-functional, including buttons that do not actually do anything.
action: Promoted real click, keyboard, reveal, and reset verification rules; treat non-working controls as blocking defects requiring refactor.

observation: 1 Devotion and 2 Devotion use laptop-to-smart-TV projection rather than smartboard access, creating text legibility constraints.
action: Updated display preference and slide workflow rules to cover class-1d and class-2d.

observation: Add a direct explanation of context-window limits because large Three.js and physics-heavy index.html iterations led to repeated AI mistakes and prompts that seemed not to get through.
action: Added context-window limitation, focused iteration strategies, and a project-specific judge answer.

observation: Add an animated visual explaining how AI infrastructure works from computing centres to student devices.
action: Added an animated request-response flow with pause/replay control and a note that the diagram simplifies most online AI tools.

observation: Add the user-supplied SVG to the final slide.
action: Added the supplied SVG as a local deck asset on the final rehearsal slide, with descriptive alt text and preserved aspect ratio.

observation: Make the supplied SVG the sole content of the last slide and use the maximum unclipped size.
action: Removed all other final-slide content and enlarged the SVG to a 1212 by 548 pixel classroom canvas area.

observation: Teacher reports the repository/library shows only one slide deck, so the generated index does not accurately reflect the accessible public lesson set.
action: Verify local versus remote lesson inventory; ensure the library is published only with its linked deck folders.

observation: Teacher wants the root library uncluttered, titled Mr. A's Class Slides, newest-first, with only week, day, and class filters; the library should cover all available slide decks.
action: Simplify the generated homepage UI, retain default newest-first ordering, regenerate from all local lesson folders, and verify every listed deck.

observation: Teacher wants multiple animated waves repeating 'First Rule of the Class is To Listen When I'm Speaking' and dislikes filter chevrons placed too close to the select edge.
action: Add reduced-motion-safe text waves and use inset custom chevrons with more right-side space on filter controls.

observation: Teacher wants the animated class-rule text humongously large and moving around the background like a worm.
action: Replace the compact wave band with oversized, low-contrast background text following looping worm-like paths behind readable content.

observation: The root-page animation showed three duplicated, low-opacity text strings and the message was not legible.
action: Replace it with one high-contrast, viewport-bounded moving text string and verify motion and reduced-motion behavior.

observation: Teacher explicitly requested that the root slide-library styling and behavior policy be added to AGENTS.md.
action: Promoted the root-library title, filtering, newest-first ordering, single legible worm-like rule animation, inset chevrons, regeneration, and verification requirements into AGENTS.md.

observation: Teacher requested that the single animated class-rule string change colour when it bounces.
action: Add a restrained palette transition at each worm-path turning point and preserve the effect in the root index generator.

observation: Library homepage background should read 'First Rule of the Class is to Listen when Mr A is speaking', shown as multiple copies arranged in a radial pattern that spin slowly and concurrently.
action: Replaced the single worm-path text with six radially arranged copies that orbit the centre and self-spin at staggered slow speeds; regenerated index.html from build-deck-index.mjs so the change survives regeneration.

observation: The radial straight-bar text was wrong: the texts must be arranged like rings that curve around a shared centre, moving along the invisible curve — not straight in any way. Rings should spin slowly with alternate directions.
action: Replaced the straight bars with four concentric SVG textPath rings (phrase repeated twice per ring, bent along circular paths), counter-rotating in alternate directions at staggered slow speeds; verified curved geometry (square ring bounding boxes), alternating spin deltas, and reduced-motion fallback.

observation: Refined the curved-ring background: more text spacing, tighter gaps between rings, more rings, bigger texts, more faded colour.
action: Six rings (was 4) at radii 125-400 with 55px gaps (was 85-95px), fonts 24-57px (was 18-47px), letter-spacing -0.06em to +0.08em, opacity 0.28 to 0.18. Each ring keeps one phrase plus a star trail stretched via textLength to close the full loop; verified arc coverage 360 degrees, zero centre drift while spinning, alternating directions, reduced-motion fallback, and pixel-level extent.

observation: Add 4 more rings to the curved-ring background.
action: Expanded from six to ten concentric rings: radii 100-550px with 50px gaps, fonts 19-66px growing outward, spin directions still alternating per ring with staggered durations; verified full 360-degree closure, zero centre drift, and reduced-motion fallback.

observation: Remove the star symbols from the ring text and use the heaviest Inter font.
action: Removed the star tails (each ring now carries only the phrase, stretched via textLength to close the loop) and switched ring text to Inter Black weight 900, self-hosted at assets/inter-900-latin.woff2 with system-ui fallback; verified the font loads offline, rings still close at 360 degrees, and directions alternate.

observation: Make the 'Mr A' text red in the ring phrase.
action: Wrapped 'Mr A' in a tspan with fill #d62828 inside each ring's textPath, so it stays red while the rest of the phrase keeps the slow colour drift; verified tspan fill rgb(214,40,40), parent fill still currentColor, rings still close at 360 degrees.

observation: Use normal character spacing for the ring text.
action: Set letter-spacing to normal and removed the textLength stretching, so letters sit at Inter Black's natural advance. Inner rings now close nearly fully (84%) while outer rings leave arc gaps (down to 53% coverage on the largest ring); verified computed text lengths match natural phrase widths.

observation: Make the ring text continuous — repeating around the ring even if the final repetition is incomplete.
action: Each ring now carries the phrase twice (space-separated) at normal Inter Black spacing, so every circle is fully covered with continuous text; the surplus is clipped at the seam mid-phrase as accepted. Verified coverage 107-168% across rings and two red 'Mr A' per ring.

observation: The repeated phrase with a hard mid-word seam cut looked broken and chaotic.
action: Replaced the repeated-and-clipped text with one smooth phrase per ring closed seamlessly via textLength (start angle equals end angle, 0-degree seam on every ring; single copy, 58 chars). Rings are continuous full bands again with normal Inter Black spacing as the base, outer rings slightly airier from the stretch. Verified closure 0deg on all 10 rings and pixel extent matching design.
